title: Returned Payments and the Switch Down Payment Percentage — Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Clause.** When a plan of the **Installment Payment Plans** billing an Owner Auto Policy term is moved off automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan, percentage points are added to the switch down payment percentage according to the payments returned on that plan:

1. the payment most recently returned on the plan posted no more than 90 days before the move (the move's date counted, the return's date not): 5 is added to the down payment percentage;
2. it posted more than 90 days before the move, and a payment has been returned on the plan in the last twelve months: 2.5 is added;
3. no payment has been returned on the plan in the last twelve months: nothing is added.

**Twelve months.** A return counts while fewer than twelve whole calendar months separate its posting date from the move. A whole calendar month is complete only when the later date's day number is at least the earlier date's day number, so a month that starts on a day the later month lacks is not complete until the next month.

**Boundaries (hypothetical dates).** A return posted on 1 March and a move on 30 May: the days counted run from 2 March through 30 May, 90 days, so 5 is added; a move on 31 May, 91 days, adds 2.5. A return posted on 10 June 2030 still counts for a move on 9 June 2031 (11 whole months) and no longer counts for a move on 10 June 2031 (12 whole months).

The returns and their posting dates are read from the plan's ledger of returned payments.
